scripts.title: Angen
scripts.features: Hello it has esp noclip speed 100
scripts.script:
local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/Footagesus/WindUI/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()
WindUI:SetTheme("dark")

local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
    Title = "angen",
    Icon = "door-open",
    Author = "by Sammy's",
    Folder = "angen",
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 460),
    Theme = "Dark",
})

local Tab = Window:Tab({
    Title = "TOOLS",
    Icon = "clock",
})

-- // NOCLIP //
local noclipEnabled = false
local Button = Tab:Button({
    Title = "NOCLIP",
    Desc = "Walk through walls",
    Callback = function()
        noclipEnabled = not noclipEnabled
        local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        WindUI:Notify({
            Title = "NOCLIP",
            Content = noclipEnabled and "Noclip Enabled" or "Noclip Disabled",
            Duration = 2,
        })
        game:GetService("RunService").Stepped:Connect(function()
            if noclipEnabled and char then
                for _, part in pairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
})

-- // SPEED 100 //
local Button = Tab:Button({
    Title = "Speed 100",
    Desc = "Set walk speed to 100",
    Callback = function()
        local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.WalkSpeed = 100
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = "Speed",
                Content = "Speed set to 100!",
                Duration = 2,
            })
        end
    end
})

-- // ESP //
local espEnabled = false
local espObjects = {}
local Button = Tab:Button({
    Title = "ESP",
    Desc = "Show player names and lines to them",
    Callback = function()
        espEnabled = not espEnabled
        WindUI:Notify({
            Title = "ESP",
            Content = espEnabled and "ESP Enabled" or "ESP Disabled",
            Duration = 2,
        })

        if espEnabled then
            for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if player ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer and player.Character then
                    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
                    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    billboard.Adornee = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")

                    local nameLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", billboard)
                    nameLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                    nameLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                    nameLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                    nameLabel.Text = player.Name

                    billboard.Parent = game.CoreGui
                    espObjects[player] = billboard
                end
            end
        else
            for _, obj in pairs(espObjects) do
                obj:Destroy()
            end
            espObjects = {}
        end
    end
})

WindUI:Notify({
    Title = "thing u need to know",
    Content = "use it for good son and dont use it for exploit like use it a little not to much",
    Duration = 3,
    Icon = "bird",
})

scripts.title: no cutscene camera
scripts.features:
THIS SCRIPT SUCKS, USE THE NEW VERSION HERE!!!!!!!! https://scriptblox.com/script/Universal-Script-no-cutscene-camera-enhanced-ver-70210

attempts to remove camera cutscenes from copy battleground moves, might not work on some games.

tested on https://www.roblox.com/games/115914910322788/Free-Shinji-Legends-Battlegrounds-MODDED (game deleted)

may cause some issues.
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local function cutscf()
	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Follow then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Follow
	end

	local livefolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Live")
	if liveFolder then
		local playerModel = livefolder:FindFirstChild(player.Name)
		if playerModel then
			local cutsceneCam = playerModel:FindFirstChild("CutsceneCameraBind")
			if cutsceneCam then
				cutsceneCam:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

while task.wait(0.1) do
	cutscf()
end
